judge.description: Engine lookdev capture of the materials milestone. Score two things: that the capture shows what this description lists, and that the MATERIALS (surface look, gloss, highlights, glow) match the reference. The reference is a finished illustration and is NOT the target for the scene: the sparse arrangement of a few simple procedural objects, the absence of characters, buildings, transparency, liquids, particles, depth of field, fog and other post effects are expected at this milestone and must not lower the score. Shows: a pastel pink plush ball and a plush penguin-like toy (deep blue furry body and head, white furry belly patch, small orange beak and feet, blue flippers, two black eyes) standing on a glossy blue floor under a bright blue sky with white clouds; soft fur with sheen and a fuzzy silhouette like the plush penguins of the references: short dense strands, a soft velvety sheen toward the edges and a fuzzy, not hard, outline (R10).
